summary: Prepared underwriting and loan sizing for Hawthorn Center as of 2026-08-31. Underwritten EGI $921,000; opex before reserves $291,240; NOI before reserves $629,760; reserves $4,320; NCF $625,440. Value at 6.25% cap $10.08MM. Loan sizing at 6.35% fixed, 25-year amort: LTV $6.30MM; DSCR $6.262MM (binding); DY $7.00MM. Maximum indicative loan $6.262MM with ADS $500k and DSCR 1.25x. Net cash to borrower ~$1.96MM after 0.80% fee, $4.20MM payoff and $52k costs. Stress case (EGI -5%, sizing rate +100 bps) reduces maximum loan to $5.31MM (DSCR binding). Delivered an editable Excel workbook with live formulas and a financing memo PDF documenting the analysis and citations. Rates, IO, fees and definitions follow lender terms. Sources: Rent-Roll.xlsx, Lease-File.pdf, T12-Statement.pdf, Property-and-Plan.pdf, Lender-Terms.pdf.
